name: Input
description: A styled native input. All native props and types pass through; type="file" receives specific styling.
intent: A single line of user-supplied text, with the focus and disabled behavior already correct.

props.name: type
props.hint: Accepted by this component and passed to the underlying primitive. Named in the component signature, so it is part of this surface.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

requiredAttributes: An associated label via ui:label htmlFor, or aria-label
aria-describedby pointing at any helper or error text
notes: A placeholder is not a label. It disappears on input and is invisible to some assistive technology.
type="number" is hostile to screen readers and to users who paste formatted values. Prefer type="text" with inputMode="numeric".
This component does not render error state. Use ui:form, which wires aria-invalid and aria-describedby for you.

usage: Single-line text, email, password, number, search, url, tel
doNotUse: Choosing from a known set — use ui:select
Searching a large set with filtering — use ui:command
Any input without a ui:label, which is never acceptable
Error communicated by border colour alone

agentRules: Never render an Input without an associated Label.
Set autoComplete on anything a browser can fill.
Use ui:form for validation rather than hand-wiring aria-describedby.

gaps.reason: No Figma file, node, or Code Connect mapping in the spec or manifest.
No variants declared in manifest, source unions, or spec table.
